Alex: Heads-up — docs PR #4523 is blocked. I added the SDK example for streaming+retry but runtime behavior around fallback-to-sync and default retry/backoff is ambiguous. Need an explicit confirmation from runtime before we merge.
Megan: cc @raj — can you confirm the default when streaming fails mid-response? docs preview flagged a behavioral note is missing. :eyes:
Raj: quick answer: by default we try streaming first, on partial-stream failure we fallback to a compatible non-streaming variant for the remainder of the request. Retries follow the SDK retry policy, not the streaming fallback. So two separate mechanisms.
Alex: do you mean the fallback is a full non-streamed call for the *rest* of the tokens, or a fresh call from scratch? I wrote the snippet assuming we continue from the last committed token (KV cache resume).
Raj: it's a fresh call from the start of the incomplete completion; we do not attempt to stitch partial streamed chunks. The server sets a header `x-fallback-reason` when this happens. We can add that note to the API behavior section.
Sam: hmm — that's a migration concern. If customers cache partial responses locally, their client-side reassembly might break. Should we add a short migration note?
Alex: good point, I can add a "migration" subsection. Also the preview CI flagged our SDK snippet for using `client.stream()` with an implicit retry — need to be explicit in the example.
CI-Bot: :warning: docs-preview failed — linkcheck 1 error, build 1 failed. Preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/4523 — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/xyz/4523/logs
Alex: copying the failing log for linkcheck: `Broken link: /api/v1/streaming#fallback-behavior` — I referenced a header that doesn't exist yet. Will add the header after we confirm wording.
Docs-Bot: checklist update: [x] PR opened, [ ] runtime confirmed, [ ] migration note, [ ] snippet updated, [ ] preview green
Megan: @Raj if you can confirm the exact header name and an example value, I'll hold the merge until we have a one-sentence authoritative note. Can you also confirm default retry/backoff values applied by the SDK vs server?
Raj: confirmed header is `x-redwood-fallback: reason=partial-stream`. SDK retry/backoff defaults: 3 attempts, exponential backoff starting at 200ms with jitter (client-side). Server-side rate-limit/backoff headers are separate. I'll paste the minimal wording for you to drop in.
Raj: "When streaming fails mid-request the server will signal a fallback via the `x-redwood-fallback` response header (example: `x-redwood-fallback: reason=partial-stream`). In that case the platform will serve a non-streamed completion to satisfy the request; clients should not assume streamed chunk continuity. SDK retries are client-side (3 attempts, exponential backoff starting at 200ms with jitter) and are independent of streaming fallback behavior."
Alex: added the header text and updated the SDK snippet to explicitly set `maxRetries: 3` and to check `response.headers.get('x-redwood-fallback')`. Pushed commit 8f3a.
CI-Bot: :information_source: Re-running preview for PR #4523 — https://preview.redwood.ai/4523 (run 2).
CI-Bot: :white_check_mark: Preview succeeded. Linkcheck: OK.
Megan: thanks. Two tiny nits in the snippet (var name and a comment) — can you fix and I'll approve.
Alex: fixed the nits, pushed commit 8f3b.
Sam: added a short migration note suggesting teams that rely on partial-chunk reassembly should either (a) store full completions server-side or (b) handle dedup by tracking full-sentence boundaries.
Megan: LGTM. Approving now. :thumbsup:
Docs-Bot: Merge hold released (all reviewers approved, CI green).
Alex: merging now. Thanks everyone.
Raj: one follow-up: I'll add the `x-redwood-fallback` header to the public API reference after this lands, so the link you referenced will exist.
Megan: great — please ping when it's live so we can link it from the migration note.
Alex: done. Closing thread.
